name: cascadeguard
description: CascadeGuard - AI system that predicts cascading software failures, identifies root causes, and recommends optimal recovery strategies before the system crashes.

scripts.smoke: vite build --ssr src/core/smoke.ts --outDir tmp-smoke-bundle --logLevel error && node tmp-smoke-bundle/smoke.js
scripts.evaluate: vite build --ssr scripts/evaluate.ts --outDir tmp-eval --logLevel error && node tmp-eval/evaluate.js
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm smoke && pnpm evaluate && pnpm build
